description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based Database Viewer UI, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for interacting with backend APIs to display databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database and loads the tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table, managing wide content display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
